what_landed: One coupled scenario that arms the three target-side terms a basic-attack swing meets on its way into a defender, and the derived guard that makes arming them mandatory. survival.pricing.price_declared_packet carries what damage._mitigate carries -- a resistance and the holder's own amps -- while a packet delivered as a swing is priced by damage._mitigate_basic_attack_swing, which meets the target's critical-strike damage multiplier, the plating multiplier damage._apply_target_basic_damage_reduction applies, and Warden's Mail's Rock Solid. Ruling 1 folds the first two, because a pure factor on a linear mitigation composes into the declared magnitude; Rock Solid never folds, because min(flat, per_hit x cap) is a capped flat SUBTRACTION applied to the crit and non-crit branches separately and no magnitude a declaration could state reproduces one. Measured over every committed coupled scenario and every bench roster before the first edit: the plating multiplier and the crit-damage reduction are armed on immolate_active_bruiser_roster's Darius, and NOTHING arms Rock Solid at all -- not one committed coupled scenario and not one bench roster equips Warden's Mail. swing_term_armed_carry_roster -- Caitlyn with Infinity Edge, Runaan's Hurricane and Blade of the Ruined King at full auto uptime, into an Aatrox holding Randuin's Omen and a Malphite holding Warden's Mail with Plated Steelcaps -- arms all three against swings that actually land. golden_snapshot.capture_coupled now refuses to capture while a swing term is unarmed, reading the term mapping from damage's own swing pricing and from the behaviour catalog over every owner in rule_owners() (R-12) rather than from a list typed here, so a fourth target-side swing term fails the capture on the commit that declares it.

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 -- no baseline moves inside this commit; the capture is the integration agent's own next commit, which is the order Ruling 4 inherits from Amendment N's Ruling 3, Amendment M's Ruling 2 and Amendment L's before them: scenario, then re-capture, then the pricing stage that needs to be seen.

no_src_change: This slice edits scripts/ and tests/ only. It adds a measurement surface and changes nothing the calculator computes, which is why every leaf below is a new row rather than a moved one.

qualifying_population.rule: R-20's second half. The count is not readable off the pre-change tree by inspection, because a scenario the baseline does not hold has no leaves to inspect. The population is therefore enumerated from the committed artifacts -- scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json's own nineteen scenario keys and its metadata block -- before the first edit, and any occurrence outside it stops the slice.
qualifying_population.method: A scenario key the committed baseline does not hold is reported by leaf_report ONCE, at the node, as a single absent_to_value membership transition: _leaf_diffs recurses into a mapping only when BOTH sides are mappings, so an absent subtree is never fanned out into leaves that have no counterpart. One new scenario is therefore one occurrence and not a subtree's worth. Beside it, the snapshot's own derived shape counters move because the scenario set gained a member: the metadata block publishes four of them, enumerated by name below. This is the same population shape the three previous covering-scenario acts enumerated, for the same reason and by the same reading.
qualifying_population.predicted: 5 population members, of which 3 qualify under R-15 and 2 do not. The membership transition qualifies because absent_to_value is a transition other than value. The two leaf counters qualify on percent. /metadata/fingerprint/entries and /metadata/scenario_count each move by exactly one, because the scenario set gained exactly one member and those two counters count members; against a committed set of the size docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json records that is a move of about five percent -- comfortably below R-15's ten percent bar -- on a value transition whose abs_delta is 1.0 and which sits in no damage section, so they clear no clause of R-15. They are declared as population members that do not qualify rather than being left out of the population, because R-20 bounds what MAY qualify and a member that turned out to clear a clause would still have to be inside it. The arithmetic is readable off the committed baseline before the edit: one scenario added to the committed set is the only way either counter can move, and neither figure is restated here -- their sole home is the fingerprints receipt (umbrella criterion 4).
qualifying_population.no_committed_leaf_moves: Every leaf the committed baseline already holds is untouched: the difference set is exactly the five paths above, so the nineteen scenarios captured before this slice are byte-identical, and scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json reproduces every per-attacker total it already holds.

the_supersession_claim_lands_with_the_ca: /metadata/fingerprint/leaves is one of the sixty escalated-defects-P4-boundary.json pins, and its live claim is the window-armed allowlist's. The claim that replaces it is a statement about a baseline that has moved, so it is written in the capture commit beside the move it describes rather than in the scenario commit -- which is also what keeps that commit from asserting a value the committed baseline does not yet hold. The same ordering the previous covering-scenario act used, for the same reason.

/metadata/fingerprint/leaves.why: The swing-term-armed roster's own leaves, and nothing else: every leaf the baseline already held is byte-identical across the capture. Stated here because R-17 obliges an allowlist to state both sides of every path it claims, which is umbrella criterion 4's Amendment H carve-out and not a second home -- the figure sits inside the artifact adjudicating this exact leaf, names the leaf by its path, and agrees with docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json, which remains the sole home.

supersedes.why: This leaf is one of the sixty escalated-defects-P4-boundary.json pins, and the window-armed allowlist holds the live claim on it. This capture moves it again, so the claim names the claim it replaces rather than a link further back: supersession is a chain, every link is declared in advance, and a boundary row is never edited afterwards.

oracle_pass.why: R-15's amendment of 2026-08-14: a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change is adjudicated BY CITATION, not by verdict. The scenario occurrence is absent_to_value as the identity-keyed leaf_report classifies it, which is the amendment's first guard; it is a row a captured snapshot did not hold because the scenario did not exist, not a value that moved. The ruling that puts it there is one a reader can open, which is the amendment's second guard: the umbrella's Amendment R, Ruling 4 -- 'By integration act (R-12, R-32 -- a baseline moves in the integration agent's own commit and never inside a semantic slice), the covering scenario set gains a scenario that arms the enemy-held swing terms: a defender holding Warden's Mail, with the plating multiplier and the crit-damage reduction in reach, met by an attacker whose delivery is a basic-attack swing.' No oracle receipt is owed on it, and one may not be filed as though the question were a value question: no cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md decides whether a roster should be measured.
oracle_pass.the_two_qualifying_shape_counters: They are not behaviour leaves and they are not adjudicable by an oracle: they count the snapshot's own shape, and no cached wiki text decides how many leaves a snapshot has. Umbrella criterion 4 disowns them to docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json, which is their sole home, and the capture commit that moves them carries their one line of cause (R-34). They are listed under coupled_golden_shape_counters rather than beside the behaviour leaves for exactly that reason -- the allowlist mechanism keeps the two apart, and this receipt states no value of any of them beyond the one leaf whose supersession chain obliges it.
oracle_pass.what_an_oracle_would_still_be_owed: Any movement of a leaf the committed baseline already holds. There is none: the pair baseline reads 'snapshot identical', and the coupled difference set is the five paths enumerated above and nothing else.

armed_means_met.rule: Ruling 4's own words: 'Armed means met: a defender holding the item in a fight nobody swings at is the same emptiness with a scenario name on it, so the mapping is a two-sided join -- the defender's declaration on one side and a basic-attack delivery on the other.' The capture guard can only see what a scenario EQUIPS and what its fight params say it swings, so meeting is measured rather than assumed, by gated tests that isolate each term through the walk's own defender hand-off.
armed_means_met.the_hand_off: roster_composition.target_overrides is the function that hands a defender's resolved state to every pair fight the walk runs. tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestSwingTermCoverage::test_the_roster_hands_every_declared_term_to_a_pair_fight reads it on both enemy cards and compares each field with the sourced number the declaring item's own ValueRef names, so a registry that stopped producing the value fails there rather than arming an inert term.
armed_means_met.isolation_rather_than_removal: Every term is measured by replacing that field alone on the composed pair params, never by removing the item -- a control that dropped Warden's Mail would confound its 45 armour with its Rock Solid, and the whole point of the term is that it is not the resistance.
armed_means_met.basic_damage_multiplier: A pure factor on a linear mitigation: with the flat pair held inert, the armed per-hit figure is exactly the declared multiplier times the inert one. test_the_plating_multiplier_is_a_pure_factor_on_the_swing.
armed_means_met.basic_damage_flat_reduction: A capped flat subtraction and not a factor: the step between the armed swing and the same swing with only the flat pair inert is min(flat, per_hit x cap), both figures read through Warden's Mail's own ValueRefs. test_rock_solid_is_a_capped_flat_subtraction_and_not_a_factor.
armed_means_met.critical_strike_damage_multiplier: A factor on one branch of the deterministic blend, which is a different statement from a factor on the swing. The blend is affine in the multiplier, so the armed swing sits at exactly the declared fraction of the way between the swing with the crit branch deleted and the swing with the reduction inert -- an identity that needs neither the crit chance nor the crit multiplier restated in a test. test_the_crit_damage_reduction_meets_the_crit_branch_alone.
armed_means_met.the_coupling: Ruling 3 gives the bolt row and the copied on-hit row different producers, and Amendment R's measured block records that they are still not independently priceable: the copied on-hit strikes read the secondary subject's CURRENT health, so a subject that takes less from the bolt carries more health into them and the two rows move in opposite directions. Reproduced on this roster under the same isolation -- the bolt row falls and the copied row rises. test_the_bolt_and_the_copied_on_hit_row_move_in_opposite_directions. It is why Malphite is the SECOND enemy card: Runaan's Hurricane allocates its bolt to the second roster target, and terms armed anywhere else would leave the bolt meeting nothing.

why_two_enemy_cards.the_constraint: Warden's Mail is the component Randuin's Omen is built out of, so no ordinary Summoner's Rift build holds both and a single defender card cannot arm all three terms.
why_two_enemy_cards.the_split: Aatrox takes the finished-tank half -- Randuin's Omen, whose crit-damage reduction meets the primary swings of an Infinity Edge holder. Malphite takes the mid-game half -- Warden's Mail with Plated Steelcaps, arming Rock Solid and the plating multiplier on one card, under the bolt.
why_two_enemy_cards.ordinary_builds: Both are builds a real game reaches, which is the standard the deferral-coverage act set: every declaring item below is one a real build of that champion holds, rather than an item list assembled to satisfy a check.

the_term_mapping_is_a_two_sided_join.what_ruling_4_requires: 'The coverage derivation reads the term mapping, the way repricing_window_declarations already reads the window mapping and holder_amp_declarations the amp-kind mapping, so a further target-side swing term that no scenario arms fails the capture on the commit that declares it rather than being discovered by whoever next prices a swing.'
the_term_mapping_is_a_two_sided_join.the_declaration_side: golden_snapshot.swing_term_declarations reads the catalog over every owner in rule_owners() and over EVERY defence payload that declares a writes tuple -- which is the amendment's own load-bearing correction. The three terms are declared by four owners across two rule shapes: plated_steelcaps.plating, randuins_omen.resilience and wardens_mail.rock_solid as OpeningDefenseRule writes, and armored_advance.noxian_endurance declaring the same plating multiplier as a ReactiveRule write. A mapping keyed on the opening-defence shape alone would report the plating term covered by an incomplete set, which is the same shape as Amendment N's warning that a mapping keyed only on the holder's items reports the magic half covered by an empty one. test_the_term_mapping_spans_every_defence_shape_that_declares_one asserts that incompleteness is real, so the guard cannot be narrowed back without going red.
the_term_mapping_is_a_two_sided_join.the_delivery_side: swing_delivering_scenarios reads FightParams.from_request, which is the tree's own answer to whether a request's uptime survives into the fight rather than the request's literal. The second side of this join is a DELIVERY and not a second declaring item, which is why swing_term_covering_scenarios composes covering_scenarios with a scenario predicate instead of reusing window_covering_scenarios; the declaration side stays the one covering predicate the four readings before it share.
the_term_mapping_is_a_two_sided_join.the_term_names_are_derived_too: The terms are not a list typed into the instrument. swing_target_terms parses damage's own source, walks the swing pricing entry point and every module function it reaches, and keeps every target_<x> fight-state read whose suffix is a declared DefenseField value -- so a fifth target-side field read while a swing is priced is a new term the moment the read is written, and a fight-state attribute that is not a declared defensive field is not a term any item can arm. Keyed per field rather than per mechanic because the field is the tree's own vocabulary: Rock Solid's flat and its cap are two fields of one subtraction declared by one owner, so keying per field costs nothing and makes a renamed field arrive as a renamed term.
the_term_mapping_is_a_two_sided_join.what_this_does_not_do: It does not perform Ruling 1, Ruling 2 or Ruling 3. The pricing stage's basic-attack swing composition, the census widening to authoring-time mitigation terms with its R-05 negative, and the routing-family magnitude ownership are separate acts and remain owed; this derivation reads the three terms the tree declares today and fails the capture on a fourth that no scenario arms. It retires nothing: secondary_target/receipt_walk stands overdue and gated.

r05_negatives.an_unarmed_term: capture_coupled(swing_terms=...) is the seam and test_a_swing_term_no_scenario_arms_fails_the_capture drives a fourth term kind through it.
r05_negatives.a_term_armed_where_nothing_swings: test_a_term_armed_where_nothing_swings_fails_the_capture keys a term on Protoplasm Harness, which liandry_reprice_mage_roster equips and which no scenario holding it ever swings at. It is what proves the guard intersects the declaration side with the delivery side rather than unioning them -- the failure mode Ruling 4 names in advance, a defender holding the item in a fight nobody swings at.

measured.golden: compare clean -- 'OK: snapshot identical'. This slice enters through neither pipeline.run_fight in the pair harness nor any src/ path (R-11).
measured.coupled_golden: 5 differing leaves, 3 qualifying under R-15, all five inside the enumerated population, zero outside it. R-15's ratio clause is not triggered: the differing-leaf count is 0.03 percent of the numeric leaves, read from the report's own denominator.
measured.one_physical_cause: The coupled scenario set gained one member. Nothing the calculator computes changed, and no leaf that existed before this slice differs.
measured.the_terms_themselves: Reproduced rather than asserted, on all three, by the measurements named under armed_means_met. Two of them are the factors Ruling 1 folds and the third is the subtraction it says never folds; those are the terms Amendment R says the walk's from-declaration price does not yet carry, and this is the baseline being able to see them.
